description: This file defines an iterator class for traversing worksheets within a spreadsheet object in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: A PHP iterator implementation for iterating through worksheets in a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the worksheet iterator with a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iteration to the first worksheet.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current worksheet in the iteration.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is within the range of available worksheets.
